mostWorthwhile.text: Making the animal painting linked pigment and memory to an image others could recognize, clearly showing how a picture can represent something absent.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pigment at the wall was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision.

surprise.text: The cave echo became a song by remembering and repeating sounds in a chosen rhythm; I had expected an intermediate step.

arbitrary.text: Adding stars fulfilled the revealed goal, but the reason for adding them was not clear until the result brought land and sky together.

continue.text: I would continue: the connections between physical processes and creative expression were clear, and teaching the tested discovery offered a satisfying conclusion.
